title: 72 Chen Families Paid for This 1894 Guangzhou Hall | China Travel Expert
description:
In the heart of Guangzhou sits the Chen Clan Ancestral Hall (also called the Chen Clan Academy) — paid for in the 1880s-90s by Chen-surname families from 72 places across Guangdong. It worked as a shared ancestral temple AND as lodging for clan members traveling to sit the imperial examinations.

Begun in 1888 and finished in 1894, the complex has 19 buildings, 9 halls and 6 courtyards, and it is famous for decorative craft in wood, stone, brick, ceramic and lime. The showstopper is overhead: the roof ridges are crowded with brightly glazed Shiwan ceramic figures. Today it houses the Guangdong Folk Art Museum.

Expert Tip: don't rush the courtyards — step back and look UP at the roof ridges first; the ceramic tableaux are the real masterpiece.

广州陈家祠由广东72地陈姓族人集资兴建，1888年动工、1894年落成，既是宗祠也是赶考族人的居所。19座建筑、9堂6院，屋脊上的石湾陶塑最绝。你会为了宗族荣耀，还是纯粹为了工艺，这样去建一座祠堂？
